e-4518.knowledge_point: Identifying Entries of a Matrix Product Representing a 3x3 System of Equations
e-4518.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+4y=1 \\ x-8y-z=-2 \\ 3x+2y-2z=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/ed434344208758284aa0f144676f7dd6498a63faeb0248d18e87c4be6c3d87f2.png)

What are the values of $a,$ $b$ and $c?$
e-4518.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}6x+4y+0z=1 \\ x-8y-z=-2 \\ 3x+2y-2z=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/b9364923447e278db5ec47bef74e1a05310645b30df22d4ea5efcc0de46c6ed2.png)

is the coefficient matrix,

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/16cb1608f70821d138f0c6984038bb42d86d9fbf76d560d94d2e25bd6fdb05e0.png)

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/0abbbaf34955fa40d6cdbfa9e16cb1567ee16271d65b4565206a0f2204eedf6d.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/4b915439c3e9922d692aab4205a728160e0a1286f82fa5ebc736460901581147.png)

Therefore, $a=6,$ $b=2,$ and $c=-2.$

after.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+0y+0z=6 \\ 2x+0y+z=2 \\ 3x+4y-2z=0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 2 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

after.name: Question 3
after.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y+8z=0 \\ 2x-5y+4z=3 \\ 5x-4y+7z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & a \\ 2 & b & 4 \\ 5 & c & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
after.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=8,\,b=-5,\,c=-4.$

content.knowledge_point: Identifying Entries of a Matrix Product Representing a 3x3 System of Equations
content.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y+8z=0 \\ 2x-5y+4z=3 \\ 5x-4y+7z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & a \\ 2 & b & 4 \\ 5 & c & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
content.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=8,\,b=-5,\,c=-4.$
